answer: Each identity locks 19 POA for 15 epochs and posts a thread commitment to its funding graph. A lotus beacon selects 8 established auditors; 6 replay signed work receipts. For linked member k, the bond is 19*k^2 POA, so the next fake adds 19*(2*k-1) POA. The inlet registry publishes samples and links; failed replay burns every cluster bond and freezes its keys for 13 epochs.
